about: Session 37 per-building wall material + colour overrides for ring-1 city facades (facade_styles.layout). Colours read by eye (Claude vision) from non-held-out Mapillary photos (not in data/benchmark/*.json, not a same-sequence frame near a held-out photo, daylight only), as in diffuse daylight. material: stone|render|stucco|gault_brick|red_brick|timber|flint|glass; roof is informational. Keys are OSM ids (all street walls of the building). Session 38 additions also use Wikimedia Commons photos (CC BY / CC BY-SA; sources prefixed 'commons:File:'), identified by house number / shop name.
